Name: Crop Tracker
Author: xetyaj
Description:
The Crop Tracker mod makes it easy to track your progress toward the three shipping achievements: polyculture, monoculture, and full shipment. You simply right click on a magical stone owl, and it provides all the details!

To receive your magical owl, achieve one heart friendship with Evelyn.

[center][i][color=#ff7700]Crop Tracker is fully compatible with any mod that adds items to the shipping achievements.[/color][/i][/center]


INSTALLATION
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Remove any previous versions of this mod that you may have in your installation.
4. Download the latest version of the Crop Tracker and unzip the archive.
5. Place the two new mod folders into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.
6. Run the game using SMAPI.


+++++++++

INTERNATIONALIZATION

As of version 1.2.0, Crop Tracker fully supports internationalization (i18n).
Please contact me if you'd like to collaborate to provide non-English support to the magical owl!


+++++++++
